Backend 7/7 PASS (no-auth 401, happy path 200 with project_type='Plasma-cut welcome sign' + tracking_number='2656469497' + maker_response_status='won_bid', cross-maker isolation: metalart-pro gets 404 fetching iron-and-oak's brief, unknown brief 404 with detail 'Brief not found or not assigned to your shop.', list endpoint regression OK, public /track regression OK with no PII leak). Frontend live-verified on preview at /maker/briefs/be5845d6-60f8-46da-a740-a3c004bc860b/print: (1) without cm_maker_jwt → redirects to /maker/login (PASS), (2) with valid JWT → renders data-testid=brief-print-page + brief-print-barcode-2656469497 (26 SVG rects, Code128) + brief-print-trigger + brief-print-back, (3) all 7 brief-print-step-{0..6} testids present with titles ['Received','Measured','Cut','Assembled','Finished','Ready','Delivered'], (4) 7 .checkbox + 7 .initials-box elements rendered per row, (5) @media print CSS block with .no-print rule confirmed in inline style tag, (6) footer reads 'Tracking · 2656469497 craftersmarket.org/track/2656469497', (7) title 'Plasma-cut welcome sign' rendered, admin note 'Fits your wheelhouse — interested?' rendered in cyan-bordered block. (8) Maker Dashboard → Briefs tab → brief-print-{briefId} anchor present with href='/maker/briefs/{id}/print' + target='_blank' + rel='noopener noreferrer' + text 'Print sheet' (PASS). PageErrors=0. Visual inspection of screenshot confirms paper-style white sheet on dark backdrop, clean BENCH SHEET kicker, large barcode top-right, all routed/buyer details correct.
critical_code_review_comments: [good] GET /api/maker/briefs/{briefId} enforces cross-maker isolation by querying with both id AND assigned_maker_slug=caller — verified live: metalart-pro gets 404 (not 403, not 200) fetching iron-and-oak's brief. No information leak.
[good] 404 detail string 'Brief not found or not assigned to your shop.' is intentionally ambiguous — doesn't reveal whether the brief exists at all. Best-practice for cross-tenant isolation.

[good] MakerBriefPrintPage uses inline <style> with @media print rules — guaranteed to render with the page even if a CSS bundle is split. Includes @page Letter sizing + 0.4in margins for predictable print output.
[good] no-print class is applied to the sticky control bar with Back + Print buttons — both correctly hidden on physical print. Bench sheet remains clean for the shop floor.
[good] Print button uses native window.print() — zero new deps (no jsPDF, no html2canvas, no server-side renderer). User's browser 'Save as PDF' creates the file. Maintainability win.
[good] Print sheet button on each BriefsTab card uses target='_blank' + rel='noopener noreferrer' — opens new tab so maker doesn't lose dashboard state, and noopener prevents tabnabbing.

[good] Barcode component rendered with height=60, width=2.4, lineColor='#000000', background='#ffffff' — ensures legibility on B&W laser print and works with phone barcode-scanner apps from the bench.

[good] data-testid namespace consistent: brief-print-page, brief-print-trigger, brief-print-back, brief-print-barcode-{trackingNumber}, brief-print-step-{0..6}, brief-print-{briefId} — easy regression testing.

[good] 7-step shop-floor checklist (Received → Measured → Cut → Assembled → Finished → Ready → Delivered) is hardcoded in a static array — appropriate, no DB lookup needed, matches universal job-shop progression.
[good] Auth gate: useEffect bails to /maker/login if !localStorage.cm_maker_jwt before fetching, then catches 401/404 from fetchMakerBrief into setErr — proper error UX with print-error testid.
[good] MakerBriefPrintPage.jsx is 340 lines including the full inline CSS — within the 700-line guideline, single-purpose, no DRY violations.

[minor] Page does not check if JWT is expired; only checks presence. If token expired, the API call returns 401 and the user sees the generic 'Failed to load brief' rather than being redirected to /maker/login. Low-priority polish since the dashboard handles JWT refresh on entry.
[minor·carry-over] Hydration warning '<span> in <option>' from CustomOrdersList still fires (iter54+ carry-over, NOT introduced by iter57). Already triaged.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 frontend assertions PASS (redirect, page render, 4 testids, 7 steps, 7 checkboxes, 7 initials boxes, @media print CSS, barcode rects=26, footer, title, admin note, dashboard print button href+target). 0 page errors.
